notes.title: Achievements are here!!!
notes.notes:
We hear you ConSPYration community! Steam Achievements have now been added in the latest update. Play Solo, team up co-operatively or go head-to-head to try to collect all of the new Achievements.

Good lucks spies!

notes.title: ConSPYration 50% Off Sale!

Now's the time to join the thrilling world of ConSPYration, a spy-themed local multiplayer for up to 6 players!

This high-stakes espionage showdown starts now!

notes.title: ConSPYration Update is Here!
notes.notes:
We at Moon Tales Studios hear our community and we are making the necessary improvements to help ConSPYration shine! We are so excited to announce these Patch Notes that are now Live!

Patch Notes include:

[list]
[*] 3 New playable stages added.
[*] Mountable Rockets can now be controlled mid flight.
[*] Improved collisions and interactions with laser detection.
[*] Improved UI in Lobby including control options, character selection, team color selection, and adding/removing players & bots.
[*] Added UI elements in post-round victory screen to help display number of wins needed.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy these new features and quality of life fixes as we continue to improve ConSPYration to make it the best game it can be!

notes.title: The Battle for the Briefcase has Begun!
notes.notes:
The team at Moon Tales Studios is so excited to bring you ConSPYration! Watching our players so far has been thrilling - The tactics! The steals! And all of those "Ooops" moments! 

We want to hear your thoughts and feedback as we grow this community! We are here for you so please give us a shout!

What have been your best ConSPYration plays (or best "Ooops" moments) so far?
